title: KHR_environment_sky Gradient Sky Parameters
description: Gradient skies use color gradients to define the sky colors.

bottomColor.description: The color of the sky at the bottom, also known as the nadir.

bottomCurve.description: The transition curve between the bottom and the horizon colors. 1 is linear, below 1 makes the bottom color more dominant, above 1 makes the horizon color more dominant.

horizonColor.description: The color of the sky at the horizon.

topColor.description: The color of the sky at the top, also known as the zenith.

topCurve.description: The transition curve between the top and the horizon colors. 1 is linear, below 1 makes the top color more dominant, above 1 makes the horizon color more dominant.

sunAngleMax.description: The maximum radius angle of the sun(s) in radians.

sunCurve.description: The transition curve between the sun(s) and the sky colors. 1 is linear, below 1 makes the sky color more dominant, above 1 makes the sun color more dominant.
